newlyClosed.result: Two normal same-template cloud adoptions remained distinct, with stable unique authoritative numbering, original-intent replay and second-device restart readback. Independent bounded database readback and unchanged standard-name projection were reviewed. This is not complete multi-screen C03 UI coverage.

Actual natural crop maturity, harvest, crafting and feeding were followed by normal restart and second-device inventory/receipt comparison. Independent readback linked this batch’s exact successful intents to unique authoritative receipts and confirmed that the rejected insufficient-material intent created no operation. This does not reconstruct an earlier historical cloud readback.

A dedicated QA process business-transport interruption preserved the original pending request across normal restart; the same intent was verified once, with matching second-device content and an independently read unique authoritative action. This is not a physical network-interface outage or a committed-response-loss test.

Combined evidence covers the newly approved 100m/450m display filtering, a naturally empty 100m view with nonempty 450m results, normal retries, actual success cooldown, repeated-click suppression and no reward side effects. The display filter does not change the cloud query radius. No claim of GPS, production-cloud scanning, or an empty default 450m query is made.

cloudEvidence.qualification: The overall cloud job failed. Only independently reviewed sub-results are accepted; unrelated later package changes do not turn them into new-package reruns.
